title: Prettier Config Generator
description: Build a .prettierrc config — print width, quotes, semicolons, trailing commas and more.
howto: Tune the formatting options to your style.
Place the file in your project root — Prettier picks it up automatically.

faqs.a: Plain JSON — valid as .prettierrc. Prettier also reads it from package.json under "prettier".
Adds trailing commas wherever valid (arrays, objects, function args) — the modern recommended style.
useTabs switches indentation to tabs; tabWidth sets the visual width either way.
Save as .prettierrc in your project root.
